bugs.title: Product carousels mixed other products' images
bugs.root_cause: planWeek filled a carousel with the next-best images of the whole sector (pillar), not of the lead's product, so a Bauhaus pint-glass carousel also showed two tees and another glass.
bugs.fix_summary: carouselMates: one product per carousel (own slide set, else same product; generic pillar images only for non-product leads); lead moves to a candidate that can fill the minimum. One-off refill-carousel-slides-20261107 repairs scheduled carousels.
bugs.symptom: Bluesky carousel 'Bauhaus Style Trains Scene Pint Glass #6' (2026-11-07) showed four different products; caption named only one.
bugs.future_repair: Dry-run refill-carousel-slides-20261107 for the brand and compare before/after; keep slide sets named <name>-slide-NN in one folder per product.

bugs.title: Amplify web build fails on a type error; nothing deploys (os.elettro.com/bugs is 404)
bugs.symptom: os.elettro.com/bugs returned 404 after PR #317 merged. Amplify builds 461-464 all FAILED, so no web change after #311 was deployed.
bugs.root_cause: brandConfigs.map(brand=>brand.id) is typed as the brand-id union; .concat(SHARED_LIBRARY_ID) adds a plain string, which next build's type check rejects (lib/ai-mcp-oauth.ts:133).
bugs.fix_summary: Widen the mapped array to string[] in apps/web/lib/ai-mcp-oauth.ts.
bugs.future_repair: Check Amplify list-jobs first; read the BUILD log and grep for Type error; run npx tsc --noEmit in apps/web before any web PR and do not dismiss existing errors.

bugs.title: elettro.com/scroll freezes or "dies at #N" mid-session
bugs.symptom: The elettro.com/scroll screen stopped following the phone remote at random points ("dies at #6", "#8", "#12"). Later reports after the first fix: the phone dropped moments after connecting.
bugs.root_cause: PeerJS blip made the screen pick a new session code and orphan the phone; no heartbeat; relay deleted peers on a 410 handshake race; unknown senders and replaced phones were unhandled.
bugs.fix_summary: Own AWS WebSocket relay, relay-only page, 5s ping/pong heartbeat with 12s reconnect, never delete a peer on 410, reset unknown senders, keep replaced phones busy, reconnect on wake.
bugs.future_repair:
1. Get the session code. Filter CloudWatch `/aws/lambda/elettro-scroll-dev-relay` for it (Git Bash needs `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1`).
2. Read the connect / disconnect / drop / no-peer events in order. A code that changes mid-session means the page switched sessions.
3. Reproduce with the harness, simulating hidden with `document.hidden` override plus a `visibilitychange` event (a second Chrome tab does not hide the rig tab).
4. Follow `docs/admin/scroll-relay.md`.

bugs.title: dev-api build fails again: gmb-planner.mjs missing from the zip list, and the guard test could not see it
bugs.root_cause: The workflow's node --check list and zip -r list share one line; the zip-contents test counted every word on it, so a module named only in the syntax-check part passed.
bugs.fix_summary: Added gmb-planner.mjs to the workflow zip list; the test now reads only the words after zip -r.
bugs.symptom:
"Build DEV API Lambda" failed on develop (run 41248382923, merge commit 4fe1a72) at "Verify packaged handler loads":
`Cannot find module '/tmp/zipcheck/gmb-planner.mjs' imported from /tmp/zipcheck/planner-review.mjs`. No zip artifact, so nothing was deployed.
bugs.future_repair: When "Verify packaged handler loads" says `Cannot find module`, add the named file to the `zip -r` list in the workflow and to `package.json` build, and run `node --test tests/dev-api-zip-contents.test.mjs`.

bugs.title: Holidays page keeps showing every brand after picking one in the header dropdown
bugs.root_cause: HolidayClient copied its initial prop into state (useState(initial)); the brand dropdown only changes ?brand=, so React kept the old client state from the All brands view.
bugs.fix_summary: Key HolidayClient by the chosen brand so it remounts with fresh state when the brand changes.
bugs.symptom: On the Halloween page (`/holidays/halloween`) with the header dropdown set to Stashbox, the other brands' Halloween drafts and pictures were still listed. Expected: only Stashbox's.
bugs.future_repair: If a `?brand=` page shows stale data after using the header dropdown but is right after a reload, look for `useState(initial)` in a client component and key it by the brand (or derive state from props).

bugs.title: dev-api build fails: new module missing from the zip file list (Bluesky)
bugs.root_cause: index.mjs imports bluesky-connect.mjs (PR #248) but the build workflow zip and syntax-check lists omit it; the build's load check fails, so no deployable zip.
bugs.fix_summary: Added the module to the workflow lists and a test that every module index.mjs reaches is in both zip lists (workflow and package.json).
bugs.symptom:
The "Build DEV API Lambda" workflow failed on develop (runs 40887723357 on 2227557 and 40888467231 on 298e5da) at "Verify packaged
handler loads": `Cannot find module '/tmp/zipcheck/bluesky-connect.mjs' imported from /tmp/zipcheck/index.mjs`. No zip artifact was produced.
bugs.future_repair:
Add the new module to BOTH the workflow (`node --check` and the `zip -r` list) and `services/dev-api-lambda/package.json`; run
`node --test tests/dev-api-zip-contents.test.mjs`. Until the zip is fixed, the previous artifact still works for deploys.

bugs.title: No "Disconnect successful" confirmation next to the button
bugs.root_cause: ConnectionDisconnect navigated straight to the page; only the LinkedIn section had an anchor id.
bugs.fix_summary: Show a success notice for ~1.8 s, then reload onto the network's own section; added anchors for the other six networks.
bugs.symptom:
After disconnecting, the page reloaded and the card flipped to Connect, but nothing said it had worked next to the button. The
only message was a banner at the top of the page, far above the LinkedIn card.
bugs.future_repair: Edit `ConnectionDisconnect`; keep section ids in `connections/page.tsx` equal to the `network` prop values.

bugs.title: Disconnect button failed with HTTP 404 (then 500) on every network
bugs.root_cause: API Gateway had no POST /connections/disconnect route; once added, the dev-api Lambda resource policy had no per-route invoke permission for it.
bugs.fix_summary: Created route aqvtww7 -> integration h25cb92, then Dean added Lambda permission statement disconnect-route. Keyless smoke test now returns 401.
bugs.symptom: Clicking Disconnect on the Elettro LinkedIn card showed "Disconnect failed (HTTP 404)".
bugs.future_repair:
See `repairs/api-gateway-routes.md` and `docs/admin/new-api-route.md`. Short form: a gateway 404 means the route is missing;
a gateway 500 with the Lambda working when invoked directly means the Lambda resource policy lacks the route.
